scientific_integrity: The proof is a direct conditional-word argument valid for all specified finite horizons and for stationary homogeneous loss. Exact-rational finite tests independently check identities and boundaries, but do not constitute a proof for infinite parameter domains. No external or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The optimization concerns a prescribed-time simultaneous-presence event, not first-passage times or stationary entrance flux. Drawing weights of target types must be positive; losses are independent across held types with common retention q_t at each time. Stationary strictness requires constant 0<q<1. A general dynamic-caching majorization theorem could cover the statement, and publication priority has not been independently established.
title: Strict Schur-concavity of coupon coverage under independent losses
